queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:eurosite_bookings` ( `booking_id` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `order_id` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `user_id` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `session_id` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `client_ref` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'BookingClientId we sent', `api_ref` VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'BookingReference Source="api" from Eurosite', `product_code` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `hotel_name` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `country_code` VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `city_code` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `variant_id` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'PackageVariantId from the offer', `check_in` DATE DEFAULT NULL, `check_out` DATE DEFAULT NULL, `nights` SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `adults` TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, `children` TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `children_ages` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `num_rooms` TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `rooms_data` JSON DEFAULT NULL, `room_type` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `board_id` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'meal/board service code', `meal_name` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `series_id` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'SeriesId from the offer', `guest_name` VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `guest_email` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `guest_phone` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `currency` VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EUR', `total_price` DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `guests_json` JSON DEFAULT NULL, `status` VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', `cancellation_fees_json` JSON DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'getBookingFees snapshot', `api_request` MEDIUMTEXT DEFAULT NULL, `api_response` MEDIUMTEXT DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`booking_id`), KEY `idx_order` (`order_id`), KEY `idx_session` (`session_id`), KEY `idx_client_ref` (`client_ref`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:eurosite_cities` ( `city_code` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, `country_code` VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `name` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `is_own` ENUM('Y','N') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N' COMMENT 'appears in getOwnCityResponse', `first_seen_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'first cities sync that listed it: new since the last whitelist Save', `last_synced_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`city_code`), KEY `idx_country` (`country_code`), KEY `idx_own` (`is_own`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:eurosite_hotels` ( `tourop_code` VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL COMMENT 'live rows report LA', `product_code` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, `name` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `city_code` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `country_code` VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `rooms_json` JSON DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'room code => name map', `category` TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `product_id` INT UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'CS-Cart product made from this hotel', `sync_status` ENUM('active','inactive') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', `inactive_reason` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'not_whitelisted: kept, hidden until whitelisted', `last_synced_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `availability` VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'IM, OR, ST, NONE; empty = not checked', `availability_check_in` DATE DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'the stay that proved the availability', `availability_window` VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'near or season', `availability_checked_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `min_price` DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00 COMMENT 'lowest price of the best offer', `min_gross` DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `price_currency` VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `first_image` VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'FirstImage from the price search', `gate_hidden` ENUM('Y','N') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N' COMMENT 'product hidden by the availability check', `product_skip_reason` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `product_updated_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `hotel_class` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'offer Class: Hotel, Vila, Apartament (property type)', `meals` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'meal plans seen in its offers, | separated (board)', PRIMARY KEY (`tourop_code`, `product_code`), KEY `idx_city` (`city_code`), KEY `idx_country` (`country_code`), KEY `idx_availability` (`availability`), KEY `idx_product` (`product_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:eurosite_destination_whitelist` ( `id` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `country_code` VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL, `city_code` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'empty = country-level row', `selection_type` ENUM('all','own','specific') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'specific' COMMENT 'country row: all / own (own-offer cities) / specific', `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_dest` (`country_code`, `city_code`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:eurosite_sync_log` ( `log_id` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `sync_type` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'countries, cities, hotels, full, ...', `status` ENUM('started','completed','failed') NOT NULL, `items_total` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `items_synced` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `items_failed` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `error_message` TEXT DEFAULT NULL, `sync_mode` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full', `duration_ms` INT UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL, `started_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `completed_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`log_id`), KEY `idx_type_status` (`sync_type`, `status`), KEY `idx_started` (`started_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:eurosite_product_info_cache` ( `tourop_code` VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, `product_code` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, `country_code` VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `city_code` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `payload_json` JSON DEFAULT NULL, `description` TEXT DEFAULT NULL, `pictures_json` JSON DEFAULT NULL, `fetched_at` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, `api_last_update` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`tourop_code`, `product_code`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

DELETE sdd FROM ?:static_data_descriptions sdd JOIN ?:static_data sd ON sd.param_id = sdd.param_id WHERE sd.section = 'A' AND (sd.param LIKE 'index.php?dispatch=eurosite_booking%' OR sd.param = 'eurosite')
DELETE FROM ?:static_data WHERE section = 'A' AND (param LIKE 'index.php?dispatch=eurosite_booking%' OR param = 'eurosite')
